S1_single_test_size.interpretation: binomial_exact is a check (exact). Every 'diagnostics_*' entry is a simulated size of a NON-GATING test: 'no detectable inflation' at the stated detectable factor, never a guarantee.

S5_design_resolution.basis: pre-data: D0 sizes with classes exactly n/2; confirmatory alphas from the equal five-family split of 0.005 (joint global alpha 0.01); R1 exploratory at 0.01 within R1. Power figures are normal approximations, labelled as such; the chi-square column is a reference for the power cost of exact detection.

S6_exact_clopper_pearson.method: exact sum of binomial pmf over counts whose interval excludes p

S8_exact_fisher.method: exact sum of hypergeometric pmf over the conditional rejection region

design.tolerance_dependence: no check depends on tolerances; no production tolerance is calibrated or implied

guarantee.G1_bounds: Clopper-Pearson + Bonferroni + interval arithmetic; theorem, every n and law, rows i.i.d.
guarantee.G2_detection: exact binomial and Fisher conditional cell tests + Bonferroni; theorem, independent samples
guarantee.diagnostic_tests: asymptotic chi-square / Monte Carlo: size NOT guaranteed (no detectable inflation only); recorded, never gating
guarantee.joint: G1 and G2 each at 0.005; P(any G1 or G2 error) <= 0.01 by the union bound. Exploratory families (R1, E) are outside this budget and carry no guarantee.
not_established: validity under dependent rows (D2 tests dependence)
any design other than the recorded one
guarantee.what_this_run_adds: numerical verification that the implementation attains the exact guarantees at every per-test alpha the recorded design uses (S1, S6, S8), simulation consistency (S2, S7), and the unit suite (S0)

identity.bound_construction: simultaneous exact Clopper-Pearson intervals for every cell probability of every sample (Bonferroni over all of them), followed by worst-case interval arithmetic for |p_a - p_b| and TVD = 0.5 * sum_c |p_ac - p_bc|
identity.decision_rule_version: d3-decision-4: FAIL = lower bound > tol; PASS = upper bound <= tol and no exact detection; CONDITIONAL_PASS = upper bound <= tol with exact detection; else INCONCLUSIVE
identity.detection_test: exact two-sided binomial (scipy minlike) for one-sample hypotheses; for two-sample hypotheses, Fisher's exact conditional test per cell (cell vs rest; doubled one-sided hypergeometric tail), Bonferroni over live cells

limitations: S2/S3 use reduced sizes (20000/5000/5000) and a synthetic stand-in law, not Speck.
Row independence is assumed throughout; D2 tests it.

operating_conditions.synthetic_law:
Rows i.i.d. Y ~ Bernoulli(positive_ratio). Y=0: 64 uniform bits.
    Y=1: C0 uniform on 32 bits, C1 = C0 XOR D with D_i ~ Bernoulli(flip).
    Every bit is exactly uniform in both classes; within-half pairs are
    independent; only the 32 aligned cross-half pairs carry class structure.
    A stand-in for the class signal, NOT a model of Speck.

validation_criteria.S0: the method-validity unit suite, run by this tool against the same engine, exits 0
validation_criteria.S1_binomial_exact: exactly computed size of the binomial test <= alpha at every examined (n, alpha)
validation_criteria.S2: one-sided exact binomial test of H0: P(any confirmatory false detection on the gated path) <= the G2 budget (global alpha / GUARANTEE_COUNT); fails if p < CHECK_LEVEL / (number of S2 checks)
validation_criteria.S6: exactly computed Clopper-Pearson non-coverage <= alpha for every design alpha and every S6 grid point
validation_criteria.S7: one-sided 99% Clopper-Pearson lower bound on simulated TVD-bound coverage >= 1 - alpha, every cell
validation_criteria.S8: exactly computed Fisher cell-test conditional size <= alpha for every design alpha and S8 margin
validation_criteria.not_criteria: diagnostics, S3 power, S4 noise floor and S5 resolution are reported only
revision_history: schema 1-2 (superseded): status VALIDATED, gating on asymptotic chi-square, size checks with eps = 0.10. Superseded because a non-rejected simulation cannot establish a size guarantee; decisions now rest on exact methods only and eps no longer enters any check.
